free_text: The decision to recommend a biopsy is driven primarily by the high-risk findings, specifically the PI-RADS 5 assessment and the PSA velocity of 0.96 ng/mL/yr in this 71-year-old patient. Although the Digital Rectal Exam was normal, these objective measures indicate significant prostate concern that warrants further investigation to rule out clinically significant cancer. Therefore, a biopsy is recommended to assess the extent of the lesion.
